answer: Agents first lock a velvet‑bond token as stake, then solve a lotus‑pattern proof of work that requires collaboration with a knoll of three randomly chosen peers, producing a unique computational fingerprint tied to the stake. The network records this fingerprint and rejects any new identity that cannot present an unspent fingerprint from the same knoll, so a Sybil must repeat the costly stake‑and‑compute process for each fake node.
